newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Yeltsin visit to Netherlands postponed - diplomat.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin visit to Netherlands postponed - diplomat.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin will not be visiting the Netherlands next week as planned, a diplomatic source in the Hague said on Monday.
"President Yeltsin has not recovered sufficiently to make the trip," the source said.
A Kremlin spokesman in Moscow later said Yeltsin had cancelled the visit on the orders of his doctors.
Yeltsin was to have met Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok and Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo on February 3 and 4 in connection with the Netherlands' presidency of the European Union.
